<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/**
 * Production-friendly authentication service.
 *
 * Clean, maintainable authentication layer with:
 * - Strict input validation
 * - Secure password handling (password_hash/password_verify)
 * - Predictable control flow
 * - Comprehensive logging hooks
 * - Audit-friendly design
 */

final class AuthenticationResult
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly bool $success,
        public readonly ?array $user = null,
        public readonly ?string $message = null
    ) {
    }
}

final class AuthenticationService
{
    /** @var callable */
    private $userFetcher;

    /** @var callable */
    private $passwordVerifier;

    /** @var callable|null */
    private $auditLogger;

    /** @var int */
    private $maxLoginAttempts = 5;

    /** @var int */
    private $lockoutDuration = 900; // 15 minutes

    /** @var array<string, int> */
    private $failedAttempts = [];

    public function __construct(
        callable $userFetcher,
        ?callable $passwordVerifier = null,
        ?callable $auditLogger = null
    ) {
        $this->userFetcher = $userFetcher;
        $this->passwordVerifier = $passwordVerifier ?? static fn (string $password, string $hash): bool => password_verify($password, $hash);
        $this->auditLogger = $auditLogger;
    }

    public function authenticate(string $identifier, string $password): AuthenticationResult
    {
        $identifier = $this->normalizeIdentifier($identifier);

        // Input validation
        if ($identifier === '' || $password === '') {
            $this->log('authentication.failed', ['reason' => 'empty_credentials']);
            return new AuthenticationResult(false, null, 'Invalid credentials.');
        }

        // Rate limiting check
        if ($this->isRateLimited($identifier)) {
            $this->log('authentication.failed', ['reason' => 'rate_limited', 'identifier' => $identifier]);
            return new AuthenticationResult(false, null, 'Too many failed attempts. Please try again later.');
        }

        // Fetch user
        $user = $this->fetchUser($identifier);
        if ($user === null) {
            $this->recordFailedAttempt($identifier);
            $this->log('authentication.failed', ['reason' => 'user_not_found', 'identifier' => $identifier]);
            return new AuthenticationResult(false, null, 'Invalid credentials.');
        }

        // Account eligibility check
        if (!$this->isAccountEligible($user)) {
            $this->log('authentication.failed', [
                'reason' => 'account_ineligible',
                'identifier' => $identifier,
                'user_id' => $user['id'] ?? null,
            ]);
            return new AuthenticationResult(false, null, 'Account is unavailable.');
        }

        // Password verification
        $hash = (string) ($user['password_hash'] ?? '');
        if ($hash === '' || !$this->verifyPassword($password, $hash)) {
            $this->recordFailedAttempt($identifier);
            $this->log('authentication.failed', [
                'reason' => 'password_mismatch',
                'identifier' => $identifier,
                'user_id' => $user['id'] ?? null,
            ]);
            return new AuthenticationResult(false, null, 'Invalid credentials.');
        }

        // Password rehash check (for upgrading hash algorithms)
        if (password_needs_rehash($hash, PASSWORD_DEFAULT)) {
            $this->log('authentication.rehash_needed', [
                'identifier' => $identifier,
                'user_id' => $user['id'] ?? null,
            ]);
        }

        // Success - clear failed attempts and return sanitized user
        $this->clearFailedAttempts($identifier);
        $sanitizedUser = $this->sanitizeUser($user);
        $this->log('authentication.succeeded', [
            'identifier' => $identifier,
            'user_id' => $sanitizedUser['id'] ?? null,
        ]);

        return new AuthenticationResult(true, $sanitizedUser, null);
    }

    /**
     * Hash a password securely using PHP's built-in password hashing.
     */
    public static function hashPassword(string $password): string
    {
        return password_hash($password, PASSWORD_DEFAULT, ['cost' => 12]);
    }

    /**
     * Verify a password against a hash.
     */
    public function verifyPassword(string $password, string $hash): bool
    {
        return (bool) ($this->passwordVerifier)($password, $hash);
    }

    /**
     * Check if password needs rehashing.
     */
    public static function needsRehash(string $hash): bool
    {
        return password_needs_rehash($hash, PASSWORD_DEFAULT);
    }

    private function fetchUser(string $identifier): ?array
    {
        $user = ($this->userFetcher)($identifier);
        return is_array($user) ? $user : null;
    }

    private function normalizeIdentifier(string $identifier): string
    {
        return trim(mb_strtolower($identifier));
    }

    private function isAccountEligible(array $user): bool
    {
        // Check deletion flag
        if (array_key_exists('is_deleted', $user) && (bool) $user['is_deleted']) {
            return false;
        }

        // Check active flag
        if (array_key_exists('is_active', $user) && !(bool) $user['is_active']) {
            return false;
        }

        // Check status field
        if (array_key_exists('status', $user)) {
            $status = strtolower((string) $user['status']);
            if (in_array($status, ['disabled', 'deleted', 'blocked', 'suspended'], true)) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        // Check expiration
        if (array_key_exists('expires_at', $user) && $user['expires_at'] !== null) {
            $expiresAt = is_numeric($user['expires_at'])
                ? (int) $user['expires_at']
                : strtotime((string) $user['expires_at']);

            if ($expiresAt !== false && $expiresAt < time()) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private function sanitizeUser(array $user): array
    {
        // Remove sensitive fields before returning
        unset(
            $user['password'],
            $user['password_hash'],
            $user['reset_token'],
            $user['remember_token'],
            $user['two_factor_secret'],
            $user['api_key']
        );

        return $user;
    }

    private function isRateLimited(string $identifier): bool
    {
        $key = $identifier;
        if (!isset($this->failedAttempts[$key])) {
            return false;
        }

        $attempts = $this->failedAttempts[$key];
        $lastAttemptTime = $attempts['time'] ?? 0;
        $count = $attempts['count'] ?? 0;

        // Reset if lockout period has passed
        if ($lastAttemptTime > 0 && (time() - $lastAttemptTime) > $this->lockoutDuration) {
            unset($this->failedAttempts[$key]);
            return false;
        }

        return $count >= $this->maxLoginAttempts;
    }

    private function recordFailedAttempt(string $identifier): void
    {
        $key = $identifier;
        if (!isset($this->failedAttempts[$key])) {
            $this->failedAttempts[$key] = ['count' => 0, 'time' => 0];
        }

        // Reset count if lockout period has passed
        $lastAttemptTime = $this->failedAttempts[$key]['time'] ?? 0;
        if ($lastAttemptTime > 0 && (time() - $lastAttemptTime) > $this->lockoutDuration) {
            $this->failedAttempts[$key]['count'] = 0;
        }

        $this->failedAttempts[$key]['count']++;
        $this->failedAttempts[$key]['time'] = time();
    }

    private function clearFailedAttempts(string $identifier): void
    {
        unset($this->failedAttempts[$identifier]);
    }

    private function log(string $event, array $context = []): void
    {
        if ($this->auditLogger !== null) {
            ($this->auditLogger)($event, $context);
        }
    }
}

if (!function_exists('authenticate_user')) {
    /**
     * Convenience function for functional-style authentication.
     *
     * @param string $identifier Username or email
     * @param string $password Plain-text password
     * @param callable $userFetcher Function that takes identifier and returns user array or null
     * @param callable|null $auditLogger Optional audit logging function
     * @return array ['success' => bool, 'user' => array|null, 'message' => string|null]
     */
    function authenticate_user(
        string $identifier,
        string $password,
        callable $userFetcher,
        ?callable $auditLogger = null
    ): array {
        $service = new AuthenticationService($userFetcher, null, $auditLogger);
        $result = $service->authenticate($identifier, $password);

        return [
            'success' => $result->success,
            'user' => $result->user,
            'message' => $result->message,
        ];
    }
}

/**
 * Session management helpers.
 */
if (!function_exists('create_user_session')) {
    /**
     * Create a secure user session.
     *
     * @param array $user User data (sanitized)
     * @param int $ttl Session time-to-live in seconds (default: 1 hour)
     * @return string Session ID
     */
    function create_user_session(array $user, int $ttl = 3600): string
    {
        $sessionId = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
        $sessionData = [
            'user_id' => $user['id'] ?? null,
            'identifier' => $user['username'] ?? $user['email'] ?? null,
            'expires_at' => time() + $ttl,
            'ip' => $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? null,
            'user_agent' => $_SERVER['HTTP_USER_AGENT'] ?? null,
        ];

        // Store session data (implementation depends on your session storage)
        $_SESSION['auth_' . $sessionId] = $sessionData;

        return $sessionId;
    }
}

if (!function_exists('verify_user_session')) {
    /**
     * Verify a user session is valid.
     *
     * @param string $sessionId Session ID to verify
     * @return bool True if session is valid
     */
    function verify_user_session(string $sessionId): bool
    {
        $sessionKey = 'auth_' . $sessionId;

        if (!isset($_SESSION[$sessionKey])) {
            return false;
        }

        $sessionData = $_SESSION[$sessionKey];

        // Check expiration
        if (($sessionData['expires_at'] ?? 0) < time()) {
            unset($_SESSION[$sessionKey]);
            return false;
        }

        // Optional: Check IP and user agent for session fixation protection
        // if ($sessionData['ip'] !== ($_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? null)) {
        //     return false;
        // }

        return true;
    }
}

if (!function_exists('destroy_user_session')) {
    /**
     * Destroy a user session.
     *
     * @param string $sessionId Session ID to destroy
     * @return void
     */
    function destroy_user_session(string $sessionId): void
    {
        unset($_SESSION['auth_' . $sessionId]);
    }
}
